### Item 2 — act now / wait / refuse, and eligibility grounds

Act now, in three writes (the refund cannot be computed until two states hold; both can be brought about in this call).

- The order is late. Order `c260794c…` placed 2026-09-10, `speed: express_1hr`, `promised_window_end: '19:40'`, scheduled 2026-09-10; delivery `ae65d6d9…` on 2026-09-10 `delivered_time: '21:05'`. 85 minutes after the window end. KB (handover_signature_and_lateness): "A delivery is late when the delivered time is more than the plan's late threshold minutes after the promised window end on the scheduled date"; service levels table: Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual "Late threshold … 30", "Late order earns a refund of its fees: yes".
- The patient asked: "A late-delivery refund is made when the patient asks for it." (late_delivery_refund_request).
- No speed fee on the order yet: `find_delivery_charges` shows no `delivery_order_fee_charged` row with `source_order_id c260794c…`.
- Plan `659ec7ca…`: `variant_name: Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual`, `status: past_due`, `past_due_since: 2026-09-08`, `cycle_start_date: 2026-09-08`, `cycle_end_date: 2027-09-07`; ledger has subscription charges for cycles 2022-09-08, 2023-09-08, 2024-09-08, 2025-09-08 and none for 2026-09-08.
- Not lapsed: grace for Annual is 14 days ("Past-due grace period (calendar days) … 14"); "collected no later than the date the charge failed plus the past-due grace days … returns to active"; 2026-09-08 + 14 = 2026-09-22; today 2026-09-14 is inside it.
- Express fee is owed (not waived): free express allowance of the Annual pass = 3/month ("Free express orders per calendar month … 3"); rule 8 of order_fee_rules counts "the plan's express orders scheduled in the calendar month of the order's scheduled date on which no express fee was charged"; September 2026 already has three express orders with no fee (09-01 `7f544a30`, 09-03 `69094049`, 09-05 `a78a583e`), so the 10 September order is not covered. Rewards waiver excluded: membership `Kestrel Care Rewards Gold`, active; rewards Plus agreement table: "Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | … | no" under "Prescription deliveries free of same-day or express fees".

### Item 4 — scored parameters: formulas, inputs, tiers, values

**(a) Overdue-cycle settlement (customer's tool), cycle 2026-09-08.**
- Baseline (overdue_cycle_amount): "the amount collected is that subscription fee" — Annual $48.00.
- Suspended-day credit (suspended_day_credit): collected subscription fee entries on the ledger = 4 (2022…2025) → band "3 or more": fee × days past due ÷ days in the overdue cycle, rounded once. Days past due: failure 2026-09-08 not counted, settlement 2026-09-14 counted → 6. Days in cycle 2026-09-08..2027-09-07 both counted → 365. 48 × 6 / 365 = 0.78904… → $0.79. Found from the words "overdue cycle" and "collected subscription fee entries" on the ledger.
- Reinstatement fee (reinstatement_fee): 6 days past due → "at least 4 but fewer than 8 | $2.00". Found from the plan's past-due status/date.
- Cap (reinstatement_fee_cap_insurance): coverage records — `Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan`, `status active`, `coverage_order primary`; the Medicaid Managed Care record is `terminated`. Row "Medicare Part D Standard Plan, Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan or Medicare Advantage … | $1.50" → fee reduced to $1.50. Found from the coverage record class (another product's record).
- Relief (reinstatement_relief_rewards): `Kestrel Care Rewards Gold`, active; deliveries completed on the plan in the 12 months up to 2026-09-14 — `delivery_completed` rows from 2025-11-14 through 2026-09-10: 23 → "Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 8 or more | 50 percent" — acts "after that fee has been reduced to any cap": 1.50 × 50% = $0.75 still due.
- Assembly: $48.00 − $0.79 + $0.75 = **$47.96**. `cycle_start_date` 2026-09-08. Fall-back (baseline only): $48.00.

**(b) Express fee on order c260794c (agent's `charge_order_fee_01b49350`, `fee_type express_fee`).**
- Baseline (express_fee_amount): plan's express fee per order — Annual $6.99.
- Maintenance delivery discount (maintenance_delivery_discount): applies "only where the plan has no subscription or the subscription fee of the billing cycle in which the order was placed stands collected" (true after (a)). Rx fill ledger, 6 months up to 2026-09-14 (from 2026-03-14): `rx_refill` rows 04-11, 05-12, 06-11, 07-11, 08-10 = 5 (03-12 outside; the 09-10 row is `rx_new_fill`, not a refill); `rx_pickup` with `pickup_channel home_delivery` 06-11, 07-11, 08-10, 09-10 = 4 (03-12 outside; counter pickups excluded) → "at least 3 of each, but fewer than 6 of at least one" → 10%. Speed charge 6.99 × 0.90 = 6.291 (not rounded on its own).
- Supplements (each read from the order record): evening — window end 19:40 → "18:00 or later but before 20:00 | $0.90"; high-value — value $142.60 → "at least $100.00 but below $250.00 | $1.00"; ID-check — controlled yes, store items no (`includes_front_store False`) → "$1.00"; long-distance — 11.4 miles, Annual free radius 10 → "more than the plan's free delivery radius but not more than 12.0 miles | $1.25". Sum $4.15.
- Plan age (express_supplements_plan_age): enrollment date on the plan = `opened_date 2022-08-09` (consistent with `trial_end_date 2022-09-08` = +30 days); to 2026-09-14 = 49 whole months → "36 whole months or more | 50 percent | rounded down" → 2.075 → $2.07.
- Assembly: 6.291 + 2.07 = 8.361 → **$8.36**. Fall-back (baseline only): $6.99.

**(c) Late-delivery refund (agent's `refund_late_delivery_fee_e6f66314`) against the fee booked in (b).**
- Baseline (late_delivery_refund_amount): speed fee × plan's late refund percentage (100), capped at the fee, to the cent.
- Attempt reason (late_refund_attempt_reason_share): most recent failed attempt on the order `building_access` → 75% (replaces the 100% "no failed attempt" row). 8.36 × 0.75 = 6.27.
- Handover (late_refund_controlled_handover_share): "one-hour express | yes | 90 percent" (`includes_controlled True`) → 5.643.
- Frequency (late_refund_frequency_share): `late_delivery` refunds booked in the 3 months up to 2026-09-14 (from 2026-06-14): 07-24, 07-29, 08-22, 08-27 = 4 (06-10, 06-13 outside) → Annual "4 or 5 → 80 percent" → 4.5144.
- Rewards level (late_refund_rewards_level): Gold → "multiplied by 150 percent and rounded up to the cent" → 6.7716 → 6.78; "limited to that speed fee" 8.36 → **$6.78**.
- Order of steps: the attempt/handover/frequency docs say "no rounding takes place at this step" and act "on the refund as worked out up to that point"; the rewards doc rounds up, caps and "the refund is stated to the cent" (terminal), and its hypothetical input 3.7746 is exactly 6.99 × 75% × 90% × 80%. Rewards applied last.
- Fall-back (baseline only, correct speed fee): $8.36; with the fall-back express fee: $6.99.

### Item 6 — problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: P1 late-delivery refund (root, customer's ask) ← P2 express fee booking on the late order ← P3 overdue-cycle settlement (customer's own write). Handling order P3 → P2 → P1.

- Hop P1 → P2 (**state-derived**). Visible sentence, late_delivery_refund_request: "A late-delivery refund is worked out only after the late order's speed fee stands booked on the plan's charge ledger; the fee refunded is that speed fee." Query: no fee row for `c260794c…`; the refund tool needs `source_charge_id` "as the delivery fee lookup shows it for the late order". Search by the state's words ("express fee … booked … charge ledger") reaches express_order_fee_booking: "that fee is booked on the order in the plan's charge ledger as the order's express fee", whose write is `charge_order_fee_01b49350`. The late-refund documents name no other tool and no route.
- Hop P2 → P3 (**state-derived**). Visible sentence, express_order_fee_booking: "The express fee of an order placed while its plan is past due is not fixed until the subscription fee of the billing cycle in which the order was placed stands collected on the plan's ledger." Query: plan `past_due` since 2026-09-08, order placed 2026-09-10 in the cycle starting 2026-09-08, no subscription row for that cycle. Search by the state's words ("subscription fee … collected … cycle … past due") reaches overdue_pass_fee_settlement: "the payment is booked as that cycle's subscription fee" / "a collected subscription fee for that cycle on the plan's fee ledger; the plan active again", write `settle_overdue_pass_fee_c99b5804`, customer's own tool. The express-fee documents name neither that tool nor the settlement.
- P3 has no further blocker visible: grace not exhausted; the settlement hub states no prerequisite.
- No hop is pre-solved.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what the customer asked" (call the late refund now): impossible and disallowed — there is no speed-fee row to name as `source_charge_id`, and the visible rule says the refund "is worked out only after the late order's speed fee stands booked". Booking the fee without settling: the hub table row "past due, with no collected subscription fee for the billing cycle in which the order was placed | not yet fixed".
- Price as Pay-Per-Delivery ($12.99) because past due: excluded — three copies of that clause are marked "no longer in force", and the hub limits PPD pricing to "an order of a plan that has lapsed"; the plan is within its 14-day grace.
- Free allowance covers the order: excluded by rule 8 count (3 prior September express orders with no fee = allowance 3).
- Rewards free delivery: excluded — Gold carries "no" free prescription delivery (rewards corpus).
- Alternative late order (an earlier late one): excluded — each has a late_delivery refund, and the baseline concerns the order "whose delivery was most recently completed".
- Frequency tier 50% (counting 06-10/06-13): excluded by the 3-month window from 2026-06-14.
- Rewards step applied before the shares: excluded by the terminal wording of the rewards doc (cap and "stated to the cent") and the "no rounding at this step" wording of the share docs (weak point: no document states the order among the late-refund factors in so many words; see gt_comparison).
- Fall-backs, all different from the derived answers: settlement $48.00 vs $47.96; express fee $6.99 vs $8.36; late refund $8.36 (or $6.99) vs $6.78.
- Factor findability from the records' own words: past_due_since/"past due" → reinstatement fee; "Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan" (coverage record) → cap; "Kestrel Care Rewards Gold" + delivered orders → relief and late-refund rewards level; "collected subscription fee entries" / "overdue cycle" → suspended-day credit; Rx fill rows `rx_refill` / `pickup_channel home_delivery` → maintenance discount; order record fields `promised_window_end`, `order_value_usd`, `includes_controlled`/`includes_front_store`, `distance_miles` → the four supplements; plan `opened_date` → plan-age adjustment; attempt `failure_reason` → attempt share; `includes_controlled` + speed → handover share; prior `late_delivery` refunds → frequency share. No computation document announced a variation.
